system.description:
ASCENDAN

Your people remember beliefs that vanished before many mortal nations possessed written language.
You may use Intelligence instead of Wisdom for Religion checks made to Recall Knowledge, Recognise Doctrine or Identify Spiritual Affliction when the subject concerns Eternals, Divine Aspects or an ancient religious tradition.
You also gain a +1-racial bonus to these checks.

Prerequisites Religion or Planes 1 rank

Works automatically: on Recall Knowledge, Recognise Doctrine and Identify Spiritual Affliction with Religion, two rows are offered with the book's wording — the +1 racial bonus, and Intelligence in place of Wisdom (the difference between the two) — tick them when the subject concerns Eternals, Divine Aspects or an ancient religious tradition.
